plugin.name: Git
plugin.description: See, pull, commit and push git repos on your hosts, and keep them up to date with auto pull.

use.title: Use Git
use.description: See git repos on hosts you can reach, and change them on hosts you can edit.

runCommands.title: Run commands after auto pull
runCommands.description: Set a command that runs on the host after an auto pull brings in new commits.

enable.label: Git
enable.description: Manage git repos on this host from the Git tab.

repoRoots.label: Scan folders
repoRoots.description: Folders searched for repos when you scan this host. Separate them with commas. Default is the home folder.

useSudo.label: Use sudo
useSudo.description: Run git as root with sudo. Only for repos that the login user cannot use.

readOnly.label: Read only
readOnly.description: Show repos but never change them on this host.

showPanel.label: Panel beside the terminal
showPanel.description: Offer the Git panel on this host's terminal tabs.

companionAutoOpen.label: Open the panel with the terminal
companionAutoOpen.description: Show the Git panel when a terminal opens on a host that has it.

companionSide.label: Panel side
companionSide.description: Where the panel sits next to the terminal.

companionSize.label: Panel size
companionSize.description: Width of the panel, or its height at the bottom, in pixels.

companionEdgeButton.label: Edge button
companionEdgeButton.description: Show a small button on the terminal edge to open the panel.

tab.title: Git
tab.error: Could not load git from this host.
tab.disabled: Git is turned off for this host. Turn it on in the host settings.
tab.sudo: This needs a root login, passwordless sudo or a saved Sudo Password.
tab.notInstalledTitle: git is not installed on this host
tab.notInstalledHint: Install git with the host's package manager, then refresh.

repos.empty: No repos yet. Add one to get started.
repos.viewOnly: No repos have been added to this host.
repos.removeBody: The repo is only forgotten here. Nothing is deleted on the host.

add.title: Add repos
add.scanHint: Looks for git repos in {{roots}}. Change the folders in the host settings.
add.folderHint: Full path, or start with ~ for the home folder. It must already be a git repo.
add.urlHint: Uses the keys and git settings of the host's login user.
add.destHint: The folder must not exist yet.

changes.clean: Nothing to commit. The working tree is clean.
changes.discardBody: The changes in this file are deleted and cannot be brought back.
changes.truncated: The diff is long, so only the start is shown.

branches.mergeBody: A merge with conflicts is undone right away.
branches.deleteBody: Git refuses if the branch has commits that are not merged.
branches.forceBody: This branch has commits that are not merged. They are lost if you delete it.

stash.title: Stashes
stash.dropBody: The stash is deleted and cannot be brought back.

auto.intro: Pulls on a schedule with fast forward only. It never merges, and it skips the repo when it has uncommitted changes or has diverged from its upstream.
auto.noUpstream: This branch has no upstream yet, so auto pull will skip it.
auto.enableHint: Runs as you, with your access to this host.
auto.intervalHint: How long to wait between pulls.
auto.postHint: Runs in the repo folder after new commits arrive. Needs the run commands permission.

card.title: Git repos
card.empty: No host has Git repos yet.
card.allClean: All repos are clean and up to date.
